integrity_statement: Uses mathematical conclusions attributed to cited authors and gives an explicit new strict-separation proof; no external independent validation or certification claimed.
scientific_limitations: Applies to normalized GDRS codes with \(5\le d\le q\) and \(\gcd(q-1,d-2)\) a positive prime power; general composite gcd not classified. Classical character formula and GDRS transfer are cited prior work.
title: Prime-power gcd strata of weight-two GDRS coset spectra
